domain.ROLL_NOTE: All taxable real property on which the tax lien is secured by the land and improvements.
All taxable property related to the active production of oil, gas, or other valuable minerals.
Properties assessed by the State BOE and billed by the County.
Taxable property of insufficient value to secure the tax lien, or property where the assessee owns no rights to land.
Properties that are tax-exempt or non-billable. Includes govt-owned parcels, and utility parcels designated by State BOE.
Mobilehomes that are assessed separately from the land.
